Summary Description: Dr. John K. Antonio specializes in model-driven performance prediction and scheduling for multi-core and heterogeneous computing environments. His work spans occupancy-aware GPU kernel modeling and occupancy constraints, CPU availability and memory paging analyses for multi-core and hyper-threaded systems, and composite CPU+memory models that guide task placement and hardware selection. He also investigates robust, model-based scheduling for DAG-based workloads, including the use of biasing strategies to mitigate errors when feedback is partial or unavailable. His research combines analytical models with rigorous empirical validation on commodity hardware and simulation platforms, delivering practical guidance for developers and schedulers operating in distributed and data-center environments.
